create_minheap: create a MinHeap instance to manage a priority queue of generic entries
push_entry_to_minheap: push an entry onto the MinHeap using the push method to add items
pop_entry_from_minheap: pop the smallest entry from the MinHeap using the pop method
access_minheap_by_index: access a MinHeap entry by index using bracket notation and __getitem__
get_minheap_length: get the number of entries in the MinHeap using len() and __len__
